output_list.criticism: The function getProtocolFeeStats is public, it can be accessed by anyone and can be used for malicious purposes. It will lead to theft of assets, loss of reputation, and even loss of funds. The protocol fee stats should be available only to the protocol. The function also do no input verification or access control, which can be exploited. Consider adding a modifier to restrict the access only to protocol. The function should also return type data type, if possible. The function name is too similar with getRewardToken. Consider renaming the function to getProtocolFeeAndRewardStats. Consider returning type data type for better function usage. Consider adding a modifier to restrict the access only to protocol. The function also do no input verification or access control, which can be exploited. Consider renaming the function to getProtocolFeeStats.
